name: Electricity Generation & Distribution Stats Brief Q1 2026
limits: National/quarterly data. It does not provide feeder-level load, line ratings or impedances.

name: OpenStreetMap / OpenInfraMap power infrastructure
limits: Mapped public topology is not BPC's electrical model. Missing ratings, impedance, loading and condition remain unknown.
catalog_origin: OIC2: OpenInfraMap & Global Power Plant Database

name: SAPP Demand & Supply – Botswana/BPC
limits: System-level figures, not time-synchronised feeder/substation measurements.

name: Botswana National Energy Compact
source: Government of Botswana / World Bank / AfDB
limits: Planning/sector document. It is not an operational SCADA/EMS dataset.

name: NASA POWER
limits: Planning-grade gridded meteorology; not a bankable on-site measurement campaign.

name: Global Solar Atlas + Global Wind Atlas
limits: Resource layers need local raster ingestion. Resource quality alone does not prove grid feasibility.
catalog_origin: OIC2: Global Solar Atlas & Global Wind Atlas

name: WorldPop Botswana population API
limits: Population is modelled gridded population, not electrical load. API results must not be converted to MW without a documented demand-intensity model.
catalog_origin: Original GridIQ dataset list: WorldPop – Botswana population/settlement layers

name: Meta High Resolution Population Density – Botswana
limits: Population is a demand driver, not metered electrical demand.

name: 2022 Population and Housing Census
limits: District population is a demand driver only. It is not electrical load or energy consumption.

name: National Energy Use Survey 2022/23
limits: Survey estimates are household energy/access evidence, not feeder or substation electrical load profiles.

name: PyPSA-Earth / PyPSA standard transmission parameters
limits: Not BPC asset data. Conductor type and circuit count remain assumptions where OSM does not map them; results are benchmark planning sensitivities only.
catalog_origin: External benchmark used because public BPC electrical parameters are unavailable

name: Utility-scale BESS cost/performance benchmarks
limits: Global/US technology benchmarks; not Botswana procurement quotes or measured Botswana BESS performance.
catalog_origin: OIC2 IRENA + external NREL benchmark where OIC2 lacks performance detail

name: Botswana administrative boundaries
limits: Boundary vintage must be controlled; official Statistics Botswana geometry should take precedence when obtained.

name: OpenStreetMap / HDX Botswana roads and settlements
limits: Road distance is not a construction-cost model. Settlement attributes need cross-checking against census/gazetted-village sources.

name: Domestic Electrical Load (DEL) Study – South Africa
used_for: future hourly residential load-shape benchmark when Botswana metering is unavailable
limits: South African historical residential proxy. It must never be presented as measured Botswana demand; raw profile not bundled yet.
catalog_origin: External benchmark allowed because Botswana public hourly load data are missing

name: WRI Global Power Plant Database – Botswana rows
limits: Database is no longer actively maintained. Current Stats Botswana/BPC figures override it.
catalog_origin: OIC2: OpenInfraMap & Global Power Plant Database
